| # Data types and definitions {#data-types-and-definitions-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

The following basic numeric data types are used by the CODESYS API. It is recommended to use them also in the application.

  CODESYS type   Storage Space   Meaning / Range
  -------------- --------------- ---------------------------------------------------------
  SINT           8bit            signed numeric value (-128 .. +127)
  USINT          8bit            unsigned numeric value (0 .. 255)
  INT            16 bit          signed numeric value (-32768 .. +32767)
  UINT           16 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 65535)
  DINT           32 bit          signed numeric value (-2147483648 .. +2147483647)
  UDINT          32 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 4294967295)
  LINT           64 bit          signed numeric value (-2\^63.. +2\^63-1)
  ULINT          64 bit          unsigned numeric value (0 .. 2\^64-1)
  REAL           32 bit          32-bit binary floating point according to IEEE 754-2008
  LREAL          64 bit          64-bit binary floating point according to IEEE 754-2008

Additional information regarding types can be found in the [CODESYS online help](https://help.codesys.com/webapp/_cds_struct_reference_datatypes;product=codesys;version=3.5.17.0){.weblink target="_blank"}.
